Individual sentences are interchangeable with the reference's. But the source's phase structure survives as five `##` per-stage headings that map one-to-one onto the source's Phase 1-4 + Final Report, where the reference uses no headings at all and carries stage order in a bare numbered list. The rubric names per-stage headings as the source artifact that caps this dimension at 3, and here it is not one leftover decoration but the organising scheme of the whole body.

Two things pull it down. A fourth terminal condition — abort when a subagent returns no report — is stated fifty lines above the decision it competes with, and it exits with no declared result at all, so it is a branch outside the closed set that the result type cannot represent (contracts.py has no stopped/aborted variant, unlike the reference's Passed | Stopped union). structures.reasoning: Every device the reference uses is present and used for the same purposes: a frontmatter contract naming inputs, output, types file and workspace; parallelism announced before the subagents that perform it ("Verify with these two subagents in parallel."); a `Subagent: <Role> (→ Type)` declaration for each of the four subagents; results declared with the arrow marker; domain types defined in the types file rather than described in the body. what_to_fix_in_the_sculpting_skill: The skill has no deletion test for responsibilities that only serve reassurance rather than the declared result, so defensive and narrative material from the source survives re-expression. Add a rule that a sentence may stay only if removing it would change what the skill produces or which branch it takes — which cuts progress narration to the user between stages, and cuts guards of the form 'if a subagent returns nothing, tell the user and stop' unless that stop is a declared variant of the output type. Pair it with a rule that the official output is the declared result type and nothing else: no additional file, filename or serialisation format may appear in the frontmatter contract or the body. Secondarily, the skill permits per-stage headings; state that stage order is carried by a numbered list and that a heading per source phase means the source's skeleton was renamed rather than removed.
